_meta.why: #915 — whether a dual-slot item may be worn as two copies, one in each of its slots. The ring and weapon rule (docs/wiki-evidence/ring-exclusivity.md, #566/#902): an item may be worn twice unless it is Exclusive or a Minor Artifact, both per-item wiki categories. A page that records a binding and is in neither states it is not Exclusive (Template:Bind publishes exclusive, default false). `slot_categories` are the page's own body-slot categories, which must name both slots the tips state.
